15.t: Working with data: a GM rice crop
q: State the yield of normal rice in a flooded field.
Calculate the extra yield from flood-tolerant rice in a flooded field.
Explain what the error bars show about the normal field results.
The bars overlap: 5.1 and 5.0 are not really different, so the GM rice does as well in normal conditions.
Discuss one benefit and one concern of growing this rice in the Mekong Delta.
Benefit: food security when floods hit, more income. Concern: cost of seed, less variety in crops, possible gene spread to wild rice, public trust.
